notes.title: Baggage Inspector - Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/d2809885741d67efefa0b419fb2bfe335c74b717.png[/img]
[b]Welcome, Inspectors![/b]
[b]The Interplanetary Transfer Station has undergone maintenance, and with the new changes implemented, your day-to-day operations will run smoother![/b]

[list]
[*] Optimization of the Suitcase Creation Process - Reduced frame rate drop duration.
[*] Optimization of the Item Creation Process - Reduced frame rate drop duration.
[*] Fixed a bug where no text was displayed on the walls of the elevator shaft.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the workroom from being selected as the elevator destination if the player entered it before the morning dialogue in the central room had ended.
[*] Code adjustments were made to reduce the intensity of memory allocation, so the cumbersome memory retrieval process runs less often.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that prevented the opening of a zipper case when it was not additionally sealed with adhesive tape.
[*] Fixed a bug related to cutting tape usage in keyboard and mouse mode, where sometimes no sound played when cutting, and the cutting process stopped after the first segment of a tape strip was cut.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the translation of text on elevator shaft walls when changing languages during gameplay.
[*] Minor optimization fixes.
[*] Minor bug fixes.[/list]


[i]Good luck![/i]

notes.title: Baggage Inspector - Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/a580bc4f68f1df939d090f0a5ae869b8067b6a13.jpg[/img]
[b]Welcome, Inspectors![/b]
[b]We’re making some adjustments at our Interplanetary Transfer Station to ensure your day-to-day work goes smoothly. 

Here are the patch notes for Version 1.1:[/b]
[olist]
[*][b] Button Adjustments (Non-VR Mode)[/b][list][*] Shortened the button hold time from 2 seconds to 1 second.
[*] After the first button click, the progress bar now fills to 20%.
[*] If you unclick the button, the progress bar slowly decreases instead of instantly going to 0.
[*] Double-clicking the button confirms the action[/list]
[*] [b]Main Menu Particle Dispersion[/b] - Reduced the particle dispersion effect caused by cursor movement.

[*] [b]Stability Improvements[/b] - Adjusted implementation details for a more stable gameplay experience

[*] [b]Luggage Cover Mechanism[/b] - Changed the mechanism for keeping luggage covers closed, aiming for smoother integration with the Physics system

[*] [b]Elevator Audio Fix[/b] - Repaired the audio-generating logic preventing perpetual clicking noise

[*] [b]Additional fixes[/b] - Fixed internal bugs and errors discovered during the first week of play.
[/olist]

[i]Good luck Inspector![/i]
